knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The operator plan and Australian guidance set the target. Generic and foreign figures are not used as Australian targets.
The textbook notes that correcting one value can throw off another, so the plan sets the order and the retest.
The proportions and targets differ, so a plan for one sanitiser does not transfer to the other without a new plan.

practicalCriteria: Operator plan is read and the sanitiser, test method and target are stated before testing
Reading is recorded with time, method, tester and plan target
No generic or foreign figure is used as the target
Adjustment is made in the plan's order and retested
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Reading record from one supervised test
Referral note where the plan did not cover the situation
stopWorkCriteria: Dosing to a generic textbook or foreign figure
Sanitiser used to correct pH without the plan
Water treatment for a public or commercial pool without the required authority
